audit_items.proof_trace: The function returns nil for out-of-range requests (endSlot < minStartSlot), causing the handler to silently close the stream without sending ResourceUnavailable(3). This violates the spec requirement and breaks P2P protocol semantics, unlike beaconBlocksByRange which correctly returns responseCodeResourceUnavailable.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker requests data columns for slots 100-149 when minStartSlot=320. The handler returns nil at line 199, logs 'No data columns by range to serve' at line 73, and closes the stream successfully without the ResourceUnavailable(3) error code required by spec.
